verdict.rationale: Phaser's own docs say games can be compiled to iOS, Android, Steam and native desktop apps, but only through unnamed 3rd-party tools. Community reports confirm wrapping games via Cordova/Cocoon for app stores and Android APKs, though one user saw slow WebGL on iOS web views. Missing for 10: first-party desktop/mobile export pipeline, any evidence of console export (direct or via named partners), named or supported packaging partners.
